enabled.description: True turns real-time on for the cohort and for every real-time cohort it includes as criteria, and starts preparing them from past events. PostHog refuses that when the project's plan allows no more cohorts with real-time on, or when the criteria look back further than the plan allows. True for a cohort that is already on, and that nothing is preparing, asks PostHog to prepare it again. False turns real-time off. PostHog refuses that while a feature flag, an active workflow, or another cohort with real-time on reads the cohort.

id.description: A unique integer value identifying this cohort.
